summary: The scheduling milestone now matches the approved scope: scheduled runs persist run_started before execution, the separate supervisor has periodic tick plus file-watch wake behavior, recurring overlap keeps exactly one latest follow-on occurrence queued, and restart recovery replaces interrupted occurrences without duplication.

checks.name: run_started durability before execution
checks.notes: The supervisor reserves the session id first, writes run_started immediately, and only then waits for run completion.

checks.name: latest-missed recurrence and single-overlap queued follow-on
checks.notes: Recurring work derives the latest due occurrence, records at most one later pending occurrence while a scheduled run is active, and starts only that latest follow-on after the active run finishes.

checks.name: autonomous event wake plus periodic reconciliation tick
checks.notes: A running supervisor now wakes both from periodic ticks and from work-items ledger file changes while a separate `mu always-on supervisor` process is alive.

checks.name: restart replacement and no duplicate occurrence execution
checks.notes: If reconciliation finds an interrupted run for the selected occurrence, it marks that run abandoned and starts exactly one replacement run for the same occurrence key.

checks.name: no incorrect model polling while idle
checks.notes: Idle behavior is driven by ledgers, file-watch events, and timer ticks rather than by asking the model whether work exists.
